item.title: Kawhi Leonard: Remains on minutes limit Monday
item.description: Head coach Tyronn Lue confirmed that Leonard (knee) will remain under a minutes restriction during Monday's game against the Heat, independent NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

item.title: Joel Embiid: Hopeful for regular-season return
item.description: Coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Embiid (knee) has a "very good" chance of playing before the end of the regular season, Tim Bontemps of ESPN.com reports.
